summary.text: Lynne Walz is a former teacher and realtor from Fremont who served in the Nebraska Legislature from 2017 to 2025, including as Education Committee chair, and was the 2018 Democratic lieutenant governor nominee. Her campaign emphasizes property-tax relief that is targeted to working families, public schools, affordability and economic growth.

paragraphs.text: Former teacher in Fremont Public Schools and Archbishop Bergan High School; B.A. in elementary education from Midland Lutheran College; current realtor.
Represented District 15 in the Nebraska Legislature from 2017 to 2025 and chaired the Education Committee beginning in 2021.
Ran for lieutenant governor on the 2018 Democratic ticket with Bob Krist.
